item.title: A lot of house for the money! 9,000 sf! C. 1931 in Oklahoma. $875,000
item.description: This sure seems like a lot of house for the money! It is over 9,000 square feet! The house was built in 1931. It is known as the Dahlgren House. It was designed by architect, Edward Buehler Deck. This Spanish Colonial House is located on .82 acre in Bartlesville, Oklahoma. The house features an attached three car garage, beautiful tile work around the front door, stunning arched doors in the foyer, grand staircase, vaulted ceiling, wood floors, pretty bathrooms, wine cellar and poker room. item.title: Pretty view from this house! Circa 1924 in Oregon. $239,000
item.description: There are some pretty views of the mountains from this Oregon house! The interior has nice potential. How about that yellow stove! The house was built in 1924. It is located Klamath Falls, Oregon. The house features an enclosed front porch, a side porch, wood floors, large wood stove with stone hearth, baseboards and arched entryways. The house could use some work, some updating and some color, but there is great potential. Seven bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,288 square feet. $239,000 Contact

item.title: $145,000! Look at the woodwork and the stained glass! Circa 1900 in PA.
item.description: This house sure has some pretty woodwork! And how about that beautiful stained glass! This house was built in 1900. It is located in Sharon, Pennsylvania. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, grand staircase, built-in seating, beautiful curved stained glass, baseboards, unique brick fireplace and a phone nook. Four bedrooms and three bathrooms. $145,000 Contact Amy Lutz with Realty One Group Ultimate: 724-201-0514 From the Zillow listing: Step into timeless elegance with this c

item.title: Originally a smokehouse! C. 1861. Over one acre in South Carolina. $265,000
item.description: I love this! Originally constructed by a carpenter named Mr. Chambers. He built it as a smokehouse for Dr. Randolph Bradford in 1861. It is located on 1.17 acres in Beech Island, South Carolina. In 1952, Mr. and Mrs. Dunbar carefully renovated the smokehouse into a private residence. The house features wood floors, knotty pine walls, exposed beams, brick fireplace and updated bathrooms. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,221 square feet. $265,000 Contact William Seamon with Real Broker: 803-270-7

item.title: Nice porch and sunroom! Circa 1920. On 1.38 acres in South Carolina. $259,000
item.description: Nice porch and sunroom! This house is nice! Love the kitchen stove! The house was built in 1920. It is located on 1.38 acres in Bennettsville, South Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, arched entryway, baseboards, paneled wainscoting, coffered ceiling, french doors, pretty sunroom and a great kitchen stove. Not sure how I feel about the kitchen. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,750 square feet. $259,000 Contact Vincent E. Price with Vincent Price Realty: 843-862-

item.title: Huge kitchen! Nice porch! Circa 1920 in Tennessee. $199,900
item.description: This house has one huge kitchen! I like the porch! Some of the bathroom tile is a bit too much, but this is a move in ready house! It was built in 1920. It is located on .27 acre in Petersburg, Tennessee. The house features a white picket fence, a nice porch, a huge updated kitchen, neat bathtubs, some original wood floors, baseboards, french doors and crown moulding. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,783 square feet. $199,900 Contact Cindy Sabaski with Dwell Real Estate Company: 615-417-033

item.title: Love the pink door! Interior has a shabby chic feel! C. 1881 in Texas. $320,000
item.description: I like the pink door! The interior has a shabby chic feel to it. The house was built in 1881. It is located on .41 acre in Stephenville, Texas. The house features a small covered front porch, wood walls, baseboards, nice size ceilings, a lot of natural light and crown moulding. The home has a large backyard that is fenced. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,304 square feet. $320,000 Contact Joelle Jackson with Winston Properties: 817-845-6168 From the Zillow listing: Completely updated farmstyle

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! C. 1912. One acre in Texas. $115,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert! This has some nice features. I believe there are wood floors underneath the carpeting. The house was built in 1912. It is located on one acre in Grand Saline, Texas. The house features a covered front porch, coffered ceilings, wood floors underneath carpeting, spacious kitchen and a sunroom. There is a back deck and a lot of mature trees. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,542 square feet. $115,000 Contact Camille Brown with Leslie Cain Realty: 903-804-6245 From the Zillow lis

item.title: Historic Junction Courthouse. Circa 1903. On 1.5 acres in Utah. $1,150,000
item.description: This is a neat building! It is the Historic Junction Courthouse. The courthouse was built in 1903. It is located on 1.54 acres in Kingston, Utah. The building was designed by architect, Richard C. Watkins. The building is situated on the Paiute Trail System and only five minutes from the Piute Reservoir, Lots of possibilities with this! item.title: Pretty details! Circa 1870. Two acres in Vermont. $279,950
item.description: This house has pretty exterior details! The house was built in 1870. It is located on two acres in Ryegate, Vermont. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, a claw foot tub, french doors, spacious kitchen and pressed tin ceilings. Pretty rural setting. Six bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,356 square feet. $279,950 Contact Mathew Gafoori with RE/MAX Heritage: 802-748-7808 From the Zillow listing: A Historic Farmhouse in a picturesque rural setting; enjoy beautiful Vermon
